caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The object is a hand tool that consists of a cylindrical handle and a circular, ridged, gear-like wheel attached at the top. The tool is rendered in various shades of brown, which give it a wooden appearance and highlight its texture and shape. The handle has a slightly curved form and displays distinct linear markings and shading that emphasize its dimensionality. The circular wheel at the top is serrated along its edge, and it appears to be attached to the handle by a narrow vertical extension. No other objects or elements are present in the composition, and the background remains unadorned except for the artist's signature, "Jennie Kamar," located in the lower right corner.
title: Cookie Cutter
